newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil's real drops 0.09 pct on lower mini-band.
newsitem.headline: Brazil's real drops 0.09 pct on lower mini-band.

text.p: Brazil's real fell 0.09 percent to close at 1.0777 per dollar in the commercial foreign exchange market after the Central Bank lowered the reais-dollar mini-band, dealers said.
The Central Bank lowered the mini-band Thursday for the first time this month, lowering it 0.09 percent to between 1.0775 and 1.0825 reais per dollar through a buy/sell auction.
The previous mini-band was set on Monday at between 1.0765 and 1.0815 per dollar.
In the interbank floating rate market, the real closed at 1.0833 per dollar, down 0.09 percent.
In the parallel market, the real rose 0.44 percent to end at 1.135 per greenback.
